review.description: Adopt override/label/assessment precedence, reuse/invalidation and visible assessment failure behavior in S1-S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Inbox priority resolution, AssessmentContext and AssessNext/infer. Background inference uses read-only configuration and yields when manual work is busy; existing retry and invalidation semantics are described.
review.tests: S1 precedence and S2 policy invalidation have direct assertions. S3 linked-context invalidation, retry timing and preemption lack focused assertions and remain explicitly open; fixture inference is not presented as a real model result.
